title: Russian earthquake weapons could set off an earthquake at Yellowstone

tellings.quote: The Russians have earthquake weapons. They can cause an earthquake at Yellowstone that'll wipe out the center US.

plain: Russia has weapons that can cause earthquakes, and could use them to set off one at Yellowstone, the huge volcanic park in the western United States. A former Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan says this to Michels without naming a source. He says such a quake would "wipe out the center US."
